options.name: api_token
options.description: FlashArray API token for admin privileged user.

options.name: client_id
options.description: ID of the API Client that issues the identity token. Used with I(private_key_file).

options.name: context
options.description: Name of fleet member on which to perform the workload operation. This requires the array receiving the request is a member of a fleet and the context name to be a member of the same fleet.

options.name: disable_warnings
options.description: Disable insecure certificate warnings in debug logs

options.name: eradicate
options.description: whether to eradicate a workload

options.name: fa_url
options.description: FlashArray management IPv4 address or Hostname.

options.name: host
options.description: Host to connect to the workload after provisioning

options.name: id_token
options.description: A pre-signed JWT to authenticate with, as an alternative to I(api_token). The token is exchanged by the array for a short-lived access token. Requires a matching API Client to be registered on the array (see M(everpure.flasharray.purefa_apiclient)).

options.name: issuer
options.description: The API Client's trusted identity issuer registered on the array. Used with I(private_key_file).

options.name: key_id
options.description: Key ID of the API Client that issues the identity token. Used with I(private_key_file).

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the workload.

options.name: parameters
options.description: Parameter values to apply when creating a workload from the preset. Parameters are only applied on the create path and are not applied when recovering an existing destroyed workload.

options.name: placement
options.description: name of target on which the workload will be deployed

options.name: preset
options.description: name of existing preset to use as the basis of the workload

options.name: private_key_file
options.description: Path to the PEM RSA private key used to sign an identity token, as an alternative to I(api_token). Requires I(client_id), I(key_id), I(issuer) and I(username).

options.name: private_key_password
options.description: Password protecting I(private_key_file), if encrypted.

options.name: recommendation
options.description: whether to use the Fusion placement recommendation based on the workload preset definitions. This will use the first recommended placement if more than one is available

options.name: rename
options.description: new name for a workload

options.name: state
options.description: Define whether to create or delete a fleet workload. Using the expand option will add volume(s) to the workload. If absent is specified together with a host, rather than deleting the workload, the host will be disconnected from the workload

options.name: username
options.description: Username the issued token should be granted to. Must be a valid user on the array. Used with I(private_key_file).

options.name: volume_configuration
options.description: Name of the volume configuration to use for adding volumes to a workload

options.name: volume_count
options.description: Number of additional volumes to add to an existing workload
